claims.claim: Follow-up Imagen Video: cascade of 7 sub-models, 11.6B parameters, frozen T5-XXL, 1280x768 at 24 fps for 128 frames (about 5.3 s); v-prediction for all models avoids color shifting seen with epsilon prediction at high resolution; highest-resolution SSR is fully convolutional; progressive distillation to 8 steps per model; 14M video-text plus 60M image-text pairs plus LAION-400M
Follow-up Wan: Wan-VAE compresses to [1+T/4, H/8, W/8]; flow matching; 14B inference about 30 minutes on a single high-end GPU without optimization

Follow-up Seedance 1.0: VAE (rt, rh, rw)=(4,16,16), C=48; diffusion transformer with decoupled spatial and temporal layers for efficiency, text tokens only in spatial layers; fine-tuned decoder-only LLM text encoder; flow matching with velocity prediction; about 10x speedup via multi-stage distillation
